# Mehedi Hasan | Business Consultant, Bangladesh

> Mehedi Hasan is an independent business consultant in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and an Odoo Certified Functional Consultant (Odoo S.A., Odoo 18). He helps Bangladeshi manufacturers, traders and growing SMEs fix how the business runs: inventory accuracy and stock control, bills of materials and product costing, production planning, the attendance-to-payroll process, purchasing approvals and management reporting. He implements ERP (usually Odoo) where software is part of the answer, and rescues stalled or failing ERP projects. He led business analysis, training and go-live for a 5-facility textile manufacturing rollout with 200+ users trained. He does not give tax, VAT or audit advice.

This site (mhasan.me) publishes practical guides on running factories and SMEs in Bangladesh (inventory, costing, payroll, process design), plus ERP selection, implementation and rescue. Older reference material covers Bangladesh VAT, customs and labour rules as they affect ERP configuration; it is not tax advice.


## Key pages

- [Business consulting](https://mhasan.me/services/business-consultant-bangladesh/): Operations diagnostics and improvement projects for manufacturers and SMEs: inventory, costing, payroll, purchasing, approvals, reporting; free first conversation, fixed-price diagnostic.
- [Manufacturing & inventory consulting](https://mhasan.me/services/manufacturing-erp-consultant/): Inventory accuracy, BOM and product costing, production planning, wastage, attendance-to-payroll, with ERP where it helps.
- [ERP rescue](https://mhasan.me/services/odoo-rescue/): Audit, stabilisation and user-adoption recovery for stalled or failing Odoo and in-house/AI-built ERP projects; Bangladesh and remote.
- [Independent Odoo consultant](https://mhasan.me/services/odoo-partner-consultant/): Independent Odoo functional consulting (not an official Odoo partner).
- [Lab](https://mhasan.me/lab/): Full index of articles.
- [Testimonials](https://mhasan.me/testimonials/): Named LinkedIn recommendations from clients and colleagues.
- [Start Here](https://mhasan.me/start-here/): Guided learning paths.

## Operations guides

- [Why your stock never matches the system](https://mhasan.me/lab/0105-why-stock-never-matches-system-bangladesh): Nine causes of inventory variance, how to find yours, the order to fix them.
- [Cycle counting](https://mhasan.me/lab/0106-cycle-counting-abc-plan-bangladesh): ABC classification, frequency, tolerances and a daily routine to replace the yearly stock take.
- [Product costing for manufacturers](https://mhasan.me/lab/0107-product-costing-manufacturers-bangladesh): Five costing mistakes, a worked example, monthly standard-vs-actual review.
- [Attendance to payroll](https://mhasan.me/lab/0108-attendance-to-payroll-process-factory-bangladesh): Cut-off calendar, daily attendance exceptions, pre-approved overtime, pre-payment checks.
- [Business consultant or new software?](https://mhasan.me/lab/0109-business-consultant-or-new-software-bangladesh): 15-question diagnostic separating process problems from system problems.
- [Dead and slow-moving stock](https://mhasan.me/lab/0110-dead-stock-slow-moving-inventory-bangladesh): Ageing report, valuation, five clearance options, prevention.
- [Rescue a failing Odoo implementation](https://mhasan.me/lab/0103-rescue-failing-odoo-implementation-30-day-plan): 30-day triage plan.

## Free tools (interactive, run in the browser)

- [All tools](https://mhasan.me/tools/): Index of every free tool.
- [Reorder Point & Safety Stock Calculator](https://mhasan.me/tools/reorder-point-calculator/): Safety stock, reorder point, economic order quantity and the working capital in buffer stock.
- [RMG Wage Calculator](https://mhasan.me/tools/rmg-wage-calculator/): Bangladesh garment wage-board grades, increment, overtime, festival bonus, factory payroll.
- [ERP Readiness Assessment](https://mhasan.me/tools/erp-readiness-assessment/): 25-question readiness score with red flags and next steps.
- [Odoo Cost Estimator](https://mhasan.me/tools/odoo-cost-estimator/): Estimate Odoo implementation cost in Bangladesh.
- [Odoo ROI Calculator](https://mhasan.me/tools/odoo-roi-calculator/): 3-year ROI and break-even month for an ERP project.
- [Odoo Quote Checker](https://mhasan.me/tools/odoo-quote-checker/): Checks an implementation proposal against 24 commonly omitted items.
